title: ks.verify: per-record rules, isolation, reconcile/no_state
outcome: Complete ADR-02 section 6 record pass and reconcile with findings 4 and 9
acceptance: Per-record rules: exec ks.control/ks.recover.* only by system principal on c-0 with issued_by == agent_id; epochs fold monotonically; expiry_tick >= tick on exec/hold; ts_us formula. One tamper probe each -> TAMPER first_bad
VerifyReport.isolation echoed; degraded prints 'per-agent attribution VOID'
Reconcile: missing state file with no state writes -> ok; with writes -> RECONCILE no_state; edited state.db -> reconcile_mismatch
summary: Blocker fixed. Verify no longer trusts the skeleton label: in a skeleton run any record with a non-empty write_set is seed_invalid (exit TAMPER), and an existing state.db is no_state. Kabir's dodge probe is now a regression test in tests/verify/test_record_rules.py, plus a state.db-without-writes test. tests/recorder/test_recorder.py now uses the acme world scenario with a real ks.seed at seq 1. Local run: 694 passed. make smoke passes. Container run: 7 failures in tests/cli and tests/runtime, which Maya is editing (RunOptions); none are in verify or recorder.
review:
[kabir · changes] Good: ts_us formula, epoch fold, system-tool rule on c-0, seed args from RunConfig, value-vs-hash on head and side (my probe: editing versions.author/seq -> reconcile_mismatch too). Recorder RecorderAborted fix is correct; test_contracts_13 ts edits follow the formula, not weakened. BLOCKER: the skeleton exemption is keyed on the label config.scenario. Probe: scenario='skeleton', seq 1 = gateway ks.dispatch whose write_set is the full world seed (IBANs incl.), matching state.db -> verify exit 0 ok. So a run that writes state dodges the D-15 seed rule by naming itself skeleton (config.json is only bound when --head is given). Fix: key the exemption on the stateless property: if scenario == skeleton, any non-empty write_set or an existing state.db is seed_invalid/no_state. Add that probe as a test. tests/recorder/_fresh_run uses skeleton with state writes and relies on this dodge; move it to a seeded run or a pre-1.3 contracts_version.

[kabir · done] Blocker closed. Re-ran probes: skeleton dodge -> TAMPER seed_invalid first_bad 1; versions.author/seq edit -> reconcile_mismatch. New dodges: world run relabelled skeleton -> seed_invalid at 1 (with or without state.db); with --head -> config_mismatch. Skeleton plus a state.db (where side values live) -> no_state. Recorder rework keeps its meaning: the clean child verifies OK, the crash child is killed between commit and append -> RECONCILE reconcile_mismatch, record = seed + step 1. 400 passed. Non-blocking follow-ups, which are general gaps and not label exemptions: (1) a skeleton record with read_set or outbox_ids still verifies ok. Extend the stateless rule to read_set/outbox_ids, and in world runs check read_set versions against the fold. (2) sidestore/ is not checked by verify for any run.

log.msg: Panel S4 added: verify checks records against config (ticks, agents, ts_us formula) without --head
